fixes.title: Give the primary action a contrast island
fixes.detail: Dorsal attention peaks at 32. No action target was detected at all — nothing on the page is asking for a click. Raise local contrast around one button and clear ~40px of space on every side of it — pop-out is a ratio to the surround, not an absolute brightness.

fixes.title: State the outcome before the mechanism
fixes.detail: Reward response tops out at 9 and no price or plan cue was found. NAcc anticipation is the single strongest neural predictor of aggregate choice; with nothing to anchor on it never rises.

fixes.title: Give the page one distinctive thing to encode
fixes.detail: Encoding strength averages 18. A page that is understood and forgotten converts on the first visit only. One unusual visual or one concrete number carries the recall.
